purpose: Final bootstrap gap audit for CFA-01 after self-design, peer mapping, World Lens design, and repository re-grounding.
reading_rule: These are CFA-01 findings and operating requirements, not new Ω law. Each item stays owned at the nearest existing semantic boundary; absence of a new CFA is intentional.

missed_but_material.name: Temporal Semantics / Time-as-Meaning
missed_but_material.why_it_was_missed: The bootstrap captured history, freshness, validFrom/validTo, revision identity, expiry, and current state in separate domains, but did not make their shared semantic contract explicit.
what_is_missing: event time vs effective time vs observation time vs processing/derivation time
temporal scope of relationships and identity correspondence
how source disappearance/reappearance affects temporal truth
missed_but_material.context_needed: A compact temporal crosswalk defining which timestamp means what at each boundary, without creating a universal time ontology.
tooling_needed: World Lens must accept an optional temporal view: now/asOf/timeWindow.
A read-only temporal trace mode that reconstructs the basis and shows why a relation/state is valid at a chosen time.
A freshness-vs-validity diagnostic that prevents timestamps from being treated as proof.
missed_but_material.first_falsifier: Take one object, one relationship, one external observation, and one derived projection whose timestamps intentionally disagree; verify that the system can answer 'true when?' without conflating the clocks.

missed_but_material.name: Observation Model / Observation-to-World Seam
missed_but_material.why_it_was_missed: World was correctly separated from projection and source identity, but 'observation' remained a property of evidence/projection rather than a clearly bounded semantic object describing how reality was encountered.
what_is_missing: retraction or supersession of an observation
distinction between observation and canonical semantic assertion
missed_but_material.context_needed: An observation envelope crosswalk that separates observed fact, source assertion, local semantic interpretation, and derived projection.
tooling_needed: World Lens should expose observations independently from canonical relationships.
A read-only observation trace that shows source -> observation -> interpretation -> world projection.
Provider/externally sourced observations should carry explicit freshness/availability status.
missed_but_material.first_falsifier: Observe the same external item twice with changed payload and once with source disappearance; verify that observations change without silently rewriting canonical identity or collapsing history.

missed_but_material.name: Principal/Viewpoint-Scoped World Understanding
missed_but_material.why_it_was_missed: The World Lens included scope/audience and the destination world model already references accessible reality, but we did not make the perspective/visibility basis an explicit part of the returned semantic contract.
what_is_missing: which principal/person/agent viewpoint produced the packet
distinction between inaccessible, absent, unknown, and not-observed
authority-facing scope without making World an authority evaluator
missed_but_material.context_needed: A small ViewSpec contract: principal/reference, requested purpose, visibility scope, authority basis reference, and explicit filtering outcome.
tooling_needed: Extend world.lens options with principal/view/scope/asOf rather than introducing a separate tool.
Return 'visibilityBasis' and 'filteredBecause' diagnostics.
Never treat visibility as evidence that a hidden thing does not exist.
missed_but_material.first_falsifier: Run the same lens target under two different principals where one lacks access; the packets must differ only where the access boundary requires, and the inaccessible item must not be reported as nonexistent.

missed_but_material.name: Absence / Negative Knowledge Semantics
missed_but_material.why_it_was_missed: The seed strongly distinguishes unknown and conflict, but did not explicitly distinguish 'not observed', 'not found', 'not accessible', 'does not exist', and 'was deleted'.
missed_but_material.context_needed: A bounded presence/absence vocabulary with evidence requirements; absence should never be inferred from incomplete retrieval.
tooling_needed: World Lens truth-state section should include presence status.
Search/lookup results should distinguish candidate miss from semantic absence.
A 'why not found?' diagnostic should report search scope, access scope, source availability, and unresolved ambiguity.
missed_but_material.first_falsifier: Query an item outside the retrieval scope, an inaccessible item, a deleted item, and a genuinely missing item; verify that the system does not collapse them into one 'not found' state.

missed_but_material.name: World Contribution / Extension Contract
missed_but_material.why_it_was_missed: We mapped Capability, Composition, and Provider as peers, but did not define how a new domain/provider contributes world meanings, relationships, observations, and projections without turning World into an integration monolith.
what_is_missing: versioning and provenance of domain contributions
missed_but_material.context_needed: One machine-readable crosswalk for domain contributions, not a global ontology registry.
tooling_needed: A read-only 'world contribution inspect' view.
A manifest-level contract for object/relationship/observation/projection contributions.
World Lens should expose which contribution declared each returned semantic element.
missed_but_material.first_falsifier: Introduce a synthetic new provider domain with one object kind, one relation, and one observation source; add it without modifying the core world semantic engine.

missed_but_material.name: Semantic Evolution / Vocabulary Compatibility
missed_but_material.why_it_was_missed: CFA-09 owns change mechanics and CFA-03 owns semantic continuity, but CFA-01 did not explicitly capture how World concepts themselves survive renaming, splitting, merging, deprecation, and cross-version interpretation.
what_is_missing: world concept identity across vocabulary versions
missed_but_material.context_needed: A semantic-evolution crosswalk that records old term, new term, relation type, validity, evidence, and unresolved ambiguity.
tooling_needed: World Lens history should expose semantic vocabulary transitions, not just object revisions.
A compare mode for concept meaning across versions/branches.
A drift detector for legacy term -> current term relationships.
missed_but_material.first_falsifier: Take a legacy concept that later splits into two destination concepts and verify that identity, terminology, and source genealogy are preserved without false equivalence.

missed_but_material.name: Context Selection Explanation / Contract Boundary
missed_but_material.why_it_was_missed: The World Lens has context in its output and the repository has D-443 assembly mechanics, but we did not require the lens to explain why each context item was included or excluded.
missed_but_material.context_needed: A ContextSelection explanation schema layered over D-443; this should describe selection without moving assembly ownership.
tooling_needed: World Lens packet should include contextBasis[] with reason, source, freshness, scope, and omission causes.
A debug mode should answer 'why is this in context?' and 'why is this missing?'
Respect D-443 as the assembly realization.
missed_but_material.first_falsifier: Construct a context budget conflict where two relevant items compete; verify the packet can explain the selection without pretending the choice is universally correct.
missed_but_material.bootstrap_disposition: FOUNDATION GAP / EXTENSION OF EXISTING LENS

missed_but_material.name: CFA-01 Operational Grounding and Bootstrap Freshness
missed_but_material.why_it_was_missed: The World seed itself has a lens design, peer distance map, research queue, and state, but we did not create a single machine-readable operating packet tying current repository basis, peer seams, open gaps, available instruments, and freshness checks together.
what_is_missing: one current CFA-01 operating context packet
known source basis and re-ground triggers
peer contact map as operational inputs
missed_but_material.context_needed: A small machine-readable operational context file, deliberately not another ontology/registry/task system.
tooling_needed: world-bootstrap inspect: validate basis refs, peer roster, current gaps, and stale snapshots.
world-bootstrap lens: invoke the World Lens contract against the current repository corpus.
world-bootstrap gap-check: report open seam status and missing inputs without changing architecture.
missed_but_material.first_falsifier: Start a fresh CFA-01 session using only the operational context packet plus linked source files; it should recover the current mission, basis, open gaps, peer seams, and next investigation without reconstructing the bootstrap conversation.
missed_but_material.bootstrap_disposition: IMMEDIATE CONTEXT FIX / NO NEW AGENT

cross_cutting_missed_patterns.pattern: World Lens is currently stronger as a semantic join than as a complete world debugger.
cross_cutting_missed_patterns.implication: Add time, viewpoint, observation, absence, and context-selection explanations before adding mutation or automation.

cross_cutting_missed_patterns.pattern: The repository has mature local patterns for freshness and falsification, but CFA-01 has not yet operationalized them.
cross_cutting_missed_patterns.implication: Reuse basisRefs/basisDigest-style freshness and explicit falsifiers rather than inventing new epistemic machinery.

cross_cutting_missed_patterns.pattern: The biggest boundary risk is not another agent stealing World semantics; it is silent semantic collapse across seams.
cross_cutting_missed_patterns.implication: Prefer crosswalks, envelopes, and diagnostic views over new permanent registries.

cross_cutting_missed_patterns.pattern: Bootstrap state itself is evidence and can go stale.
cross_cutting_missed_patterns.implication: Every seed artifact carrying counts, statuses, or current refs should identify its observation point or derive from a current manifest where practical.

what_not_to_do_now: Do not create a separate Temporal Steward.
Do not create a separate Observation Steward.
Do not create a separate Epistemic Steward yet.
Do not create a universal World ontology registry.
Do not replace D-443 context assembly.
Do not turn World Lens into a write API.
Do not treat the current peer-distance scores as objective measurements.
Do not turn this gap register into a project-management roadmap.

recommended_tooling_shape.principle: One conceptual World Lens instrument plus small inspection/debug modes; avoid tool proliferation.
recommended_tooling_shape.design_constraint: These are contracts/modes, not permission to create new permanent architectural ownership areas.

bootstrap_exit_statement.remaining_work: Characterization and contract research, not additional bootstrap framing.
bootstrap_exit_statement.identity_status: CFA-01 remains provisional until owner alignment is explicitly recorded.
bootstrap_exit_statement.interpretation: The bootstrap has enough structure to pause safely. The remaining uncertainty is now named, bounded, and routed rather than hidden.
